title: Extreme Speech Classification in the Era of LLMs: Exploring Open-Source and Proprietary Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical performance of LLMs in classifying extreme speech (hate speech) within the Indian socio-cultural context. While religion and caste are used as categories for identifying derogatory speech, the core objective is benchmarking NLP classification accuracy (F1 scores) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or frameworks.
